categories.main_business_segments: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts industry, focusing on three main product segments: noise reduction (NVH), insulation and lightweight products; electric motors, electric pumps, and mechanical pumps; and automotive electronics and control products. The company serves as a comprehensive automotive parts system integrator with a global customer base including major international and domestic automakers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core acoustic and thermal technologies, employing advanced manufacturing processes such as thermoforming, PU forming, stamping, vacuum forming, blow molding, and aluminum forming. It integrates mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic technologies for its pump and motor products and develops intelligent, integrated automotive electronic control systems. The firm also invests in solid-state battery technology with proprietary oxide electrolyte materials, emphasizing safety, performance, and scalable production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic leading automobile manufacturers such as Daimler, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, Ford, General Motors, Stellantis, Porsche, Renault, Nissan, SAIC, JMC, Great Wall, and Geely. The company serves both passenger and commercial vehicle markets, with a growing focus on new energy vehicles (NEVs) and related components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production, sales, and R&D facilities distributed across China, Europe (notably Germany), North America (USA, Mexico), and Asia. It maintains localized sales and production networks in Europe, North America, and Asia to meet regional customer demands and mitigate international trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing and supplying key components and systems directly to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and first-tier suppliers. It integrates upstream raw materials and downstream assembly through its comprehensive production and R&D capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automotive electrification, intelligentization, and lightweighting. It focuses on expanding its NEV product portfolio, advancing solid-state battery industrialization, and enhancing integrated thermal management and acoustic solutions. R&D efforts emphasize platform-based development, simulation-driven design, and global collaboration with academic and research institutions to accelerate technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of automotive parts and systems to OEMs and tier-one suppliers under long-term contracts. The company employs a direct sales model with flexible production aligned to customer rolling orders, supplemented by customized product development services. It also receives government subsidies related to technology innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global supplier in NVH, insulation, lightweight materials, and integrated pump and motor systems, competing with other major automotive parts manufacturers worldwide. Its strong R&D, quality control, and global footprint provide competitive advantages, especially in NEV components and emerging solid-state battery technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.51 billion, representing a 4.98% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose significantly by 151.73% to RMB 32.43 million. The company maintains a substantial asset base of RMB 3.7 billion with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fuxin Dare emphasizes its customized, integrated solutions in noise reduction, thermal insulation, and lightweight materials tailored for automotive applications, combined with advanced electric and hydraulic pump technologies. Its global R&D platform and quality management systems enable rapid product development and high reliability. The company’s early mover advantage in solid-state battery technology and comprehensive global supply chain presence further differentiate it in the competitive automotive parts market.
